lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in three distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal spot rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating a structured matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge line extending across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a high-contrast luminance gradient with light values superiorly and shadow values inferiorly.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated low-luminance silhouettes positioned ventrally; a large circular graphical watermark is superimposed on the upper-right region, occluding portions of the dorsal fin.
